verdict.rationale: Linear provides team-level access controls (private sub-teams restricted to members, private initiatives visible only to team members) and centralized identity/access management via Okta that applies existing Linear permissions, but there's no evidence of granular per-issue or field-level view/edit permission assignment beyond team membership and admin-set roles. missing for 10: custom/granular roles for individual issues or fields, evidence of view-vs-edit distinction beyond team privacy, independent confirmation of role granularity.
